## Description

Master Rmd for running the qualitative MSEs.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

## Functions
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(magrittr)
library(ggplot2)

#Load XML first--dependency not included in QPress
#To install QPress: 
  # library(remotes)
  # remotes::install_github("SWotherspoon/QPress")
library(QPress)
library(XML)
library(tcltk2)
library(gridExtra)
library(cowplot)


## custom functions
source(here('R/fxns/parse.constraints.SWotherspoon.R'))
source(here('R/fxns/prepare.dia.R'))
source(here('R/fxns/compare.baseline.impact.table.R'))
source(here('R/fxns/compare.models.impact.table.R'))
source(here('R/fxns/alternating.list.R'))

## let's time things
end.timer <- function(s){round(Sys.time()-s,2)}


## model variable key: I use this to order the variables in the output tables.
vkey <- read_csv(here('data','qnm_models','om_variable_key.csv'))
vkey %<>% bind_rows(
  data.frame(variable=c("offshore biomass inaccessible large","offshore biomass inaccessible small"),
             group=rep("ecosystem",2),
             group_order=rep(1,2),specific_order=rep(6,2))
  )
```

## QNM overview

create a list of lists, so that each operating model scenario (0-5) has its own QNM list.
management strategies A/D use the same underlying QNM structure
but strategies B,C,E require their own unique QNM.
```{r load_models}
s <- Sys.time()


##### 0. A baseline scenario #####
m0list <- list(
  m <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_00-constantF',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models'))[[1]],  # no constraints
  m.b <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_00B-rm-small-mesh',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models'))[[1]],  # no constraints
  m.c <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_00C-rm-small-mesh-redistribute-small',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models'))[[1]],  # no constraints
  m.e <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_00E-rm-inshore-small-mesh',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models'))[[1]]  # no constraints
)

#### 2. Effort scales according to the Thorson effort model (Thorson et al., 2013) ####
m2list <- list(
  m2 <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_2-thorsonF',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models'))[[1]],  # no constraints
  m2.b <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_2B-rm-small-mesh',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models'))[[1]] , # no constraints
  m2.c <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_2C-rm-small-mesh-redistribute-small',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models'))[[1]] , # no constraints
  m2.d <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_2E-rm-inshore-small-mesh',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models'))[[1]] # no constraints
)

#### 3. Climate reduces productivity ####
m3list <- m0list

#### 4. Animals move into the “far offshore” area ####
m4list <- list(
  m4 <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_004-movement-to-inaccessible',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models'))[[1]],  # no constraints
  m4.b <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_004B-rm-small-mesh',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models'))[[1]],  # no constraints
  m4.c <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_004C-rm-small-mesh-redistribute-small',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models'))[[1]],
  m4.d <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_004E-rm-inshore-small-mesh',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models'))[[1]]
)

#### 5. Climate increases growth rate ####
m5list <- list(
  m <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_005-growth-perturb',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models'))[[1]],  # no constraints
  m.b <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_005B-rm-small-mesh',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models'))[[1]],
  m.c <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_005C-rm-small-mesh-redistribute-small',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models'))[[1]],
  m.d <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_005E-rm-inshore-small-mesh',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models'))[[1]]  # no constraints
)


end.timer(s)
```
*Time difference of 2.24 secs*

```{r}
mlist_all <- list(m0list,m2list,m3list,m4list,m5list)
names(mlist_all) <- c("OM O","OM 2 Thorson Effort","OM 3", "OM 4 Offshore Inaccessible","OM 5 Faster Growth")
```
```{r eval=FALSE}
## check for duplicate edges
for(j in seq(1,length(mlist_all))){
  tmp_mlist <- mlist_all[[j]]
  for(i in seq(1,length(tmp_mlist))){
    tmp <- tmp_mlist[[i]] %>% unite(From,To,col="edge", sep="-") %>%
      group_by(edge) %>% summarise(n=n()) %>%
      filter(n>1)
    if(dim(tmp)[1]>0){   
      print(names(mlist_all)[[j]])   
      print(i)
      print("!! duplicate edges !!")
      print(tmp)
    }
  }
}
```


Some models require perturbations
```{r}
# OM 3:  There is a negative perturbation on “inshore recruits”
PertOM3 <- c(`inshore recruits`=-1)

# OM 4:  There a positive perturbation on “climate pressure"
PertOM4 <- c(`Climate pressure`=1)

# OM 5: There is a positive perturbation on "growth"
PertOM5 <- c(`Growth`=1)
```


Optional: write out models as matrices (for use in other programs, building FCMs)
```{r eval=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
## all
for(i in seq(1,length(mlist_all))){
  tmp_name <- names(mlist_all)[i]
  tmp_list <- mlist_all[[i]]
  for(j in seq(1:4)){
      m.mat.out <- adjacency.matrix(tmp_list[[j]],labels=TRUE)
      m.mat.df <- as.data.frame(m.mat.out) %>% rownames_to_column("x")
      
      if(j==2){suffix <- "_hcrB"} else if(j==3){
        suffix <- "_hcrC"}else if(j==4){
        suffix <- "_hcrE"}else{suffix <- ""}
      
      m.mat.name <- paste0(str_replace_all(tmp_name, " ", "_"),suffix,'.csv')
      
      write_csv(m.mat.df, file=here('data','CSVs',m.mat.name))
  }
  print(i)
}


## specific OMs
tmp_list <- m3list
tmp_name <- "OM 3"
for(j in seq(1:4)){
  m.mat.out <- adjacency.matrix(tmp_list[[j]],labels=TRUE)
  m.mat.df <- as.data.frame(m.mat.out) %>% rownames_to_column("x")
  
  if(j==2){suffix <- "_hcrB"} else if(j==3){
    suffix <- "_hcrC"}else if(j==4){
      suffix <- "_hcrE"}else{suffix <- ""}
  
  m.mat.name <- paste0(str_replace_all(tmp_name, " ", "_"),suffix,'.csv')
  
  write_csv(m.mat.df, file=here('data','qnm_models',m.mat.name))
}
```




## HCR Overview

These are the HCRs and the associated perturbations to the QNMs:

HCR A: Status Quo (empty perturbation)
```{r echo=TRUE}
PertA <-  c(`inshore small mesh effort`=0)
```

HCR B: Remove small mesh fleet, (fishery #1)
```{r echo=TRUE}
PertB <- c(`inshore small mesh effort`=-1,`offshore small mesh effort`=-1)
```

HCR C: Remove *inshore* small mesh fleet, allow effort redistribution to offshore small mesh fishery
```{r echo=TRUE}
PertC <- c(`inshore small mesh effort`=-1)
```

HCR D: Increase the mesh size for the small mesh fleet (fishery #1)
```{r echo=TRUE}
PertD <- c(`inshore mesh size`=1,`offshore mesh size`=1)
```

HCR E: remove the small mesh fleet from the inshore area
```{r echo=TRUE}
PertE <- c(`inshore small mesh effort`=-1)
```

Save into a list
```{r}
Pert.list <- list(PertA,PertB,PertC,PertD,PertE)
names(Pert.list) <- c("A:Status Quo","B:Rmv sm mesh fleet","C:Rmv inshore sm mesh fleet\nEffort redistribution",
                "D:Increase mesh size","E:Rmv inshore sm mesh fleet")
```


## Run each HCR across Operating Models

Each section runs an HCR across all operating models. Then it saves: (1) an RDS for each HCR, with the perturbation output in a list; (2) a vector with the time it took to run the perturbations, and (3) a table of perturbation results for each variable (optionally saving this into a png, if plot_out=TRUE) 
```{r}
set.seed(555)

plot_out <- FALSE
hcr_run_times <- c()

# HCR A -------------------------------------------------------------------
# simulation prep
p_hcr <- PertA   # perturbation
mlist_hcr <- sapply(mlist_all,"[",1)  # we only need the first version of the OM for HCR A
hcr_out <- list()   # empty list for simulation output

# run simulation
for(i in seq(1,length(mlist_hcr))){
  
  # load 'i' operating model
  tmp_om <- mlist_hcr[[i]]
  tmp_om_name <- names(mlist_hcr)[i]
  
  # adjust perturbation if needed
  if(tmp_om_name=="OM 3 Fewer Recruits"){p_hcr <- c(p_hcr,PertOM3)}
  if(tmp_om_name=="OM 4 Offshore Inaccessible"){p_hcr <- c(p_hcr,PertOM4)}
  if(tmp_om_name=="OM 5 Faster Growth"){p_hcr <- c(p_hcr,PertOM5)}
  
  
  s <- Sys.time()  # start timer
  
  # run simulation, save to output list
  hcr_out[[i]] <- system.simulate(n.sims=10000, # number of randomly generated matrices to keep
                            edges=tmp_om, # the qnm
                            sampler=community.sampler(tmp_om, required.groups = c(0)), # thefx to generate the matrices without constraints
                            validators=list(press.validate(
                              tmp_om, # the qnm
                              perturb = p_hcr, # the perturbation
                              monitor = NA))) # a list of expected outcomes that should happen in the simulation (I don't usually use this)
  names(hcr_out)[i] <- tmp_om_name
  
  # save time info
  hcr_run_times[length(hcr_run_times)+1] <- end.timer(s)
  names(hcr_run_times)[length(hcr_run_times)] <- paste('hcrA',tmp_om_name,sep="_")
  
  # reset perturbation
  p_hcr <- PertA
}


# HCR A 
# 15.79955s

# save simulation outputs for future use
saveRDS(hcr_out, here('data','qnm_out',paste0('mse0-5_hcrA_10K_',format(Sys.Date(),"%Y%m%d"),'.rds')))

# save simulation output as an image
pert_list <- list(p_hcr,p_hcr,c(p_hcr,PertOM3),c(p_hcr,PertOM4),c(p_hcr,PertOM5))
compare.table <- compare.models.impact.tbl(sim.list=hcr_out, # **named** list of simulations to look at
                                          perturb.list=pert_list,
                                          monitor.list=list(NA,NA,NA,NA,NA), # list of variable outcomes monitored (I don't use this)
                                          strong_lower=0.8, weak_lower=0.6,
                                          epsilon=1.0E-5,
                                          plot=TRUE, main.axis="Y",
                                          variable.key=vkey,variable.order="specific_order")
## plot (this one should show all perturbations in a single plot, so no need to use plot_grid)
plot.out <- compare.table[[3]] + ggtitle("HCR A: Status Quo")
plot.out

if(plot_out){png(here('data','qnm_out',paste0('mse0-5_hcrA_10K_',format(Sys.Date(),"%Y%m%d"),'.png')), res=300,height=1500,width=2800)
plot.out
dev.off()}
```

so, how long did everything take, on average?
```{r}
run_times_df <- as.data.frame(hcr_run_times) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var='name') %>%
  separate(col=name, into=c('hcr','om'), sep="_") %>%
   mutate(om=case_when(om=='OM O' ~ 'OM O Status Quo',
                      om=='OM 3' ~ 'OM 3 Reduced Productivity', .default=om)) %>%
  rename(run_time=hcr_run_times)

mean(run_times_df$run_time)
group_by(run_times_df, hcr) %>% summarise(all_oms=sum(run_time))
```

|.HCR A.|.HCR B.|.HCR C.|.HCR D.|.HCR E.|
| 28.97 | 29.93 | 29.73 | 29.14 | 28.20 |

save as df and fig
```{r}
write_csv(run_times_df, here('data','qnm_run_times.csv'))

run_times_df <- read_csv(here('data','qnm_run_times.csv'))

ptime <- run_times_df %>%
  mutate(om_num=str_split_i(om, ' ', 2)) %>%
  mutate(om_num=case_when(om_num=='O' ~ '0', .default=om_num)) %>%
  mutate(om=fct_reorder(om, as.numeric(om_num))) %>%
ggplot(aes(y=run_time, x=om)) + 
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill=om), alpha=0.5) +
  geom_jitter(aes(col=om), pch=21, width=0.05) +
  labs(y='run time (seconds)',x='QNM') +
  ylim(c(0,6)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position='none', axis.text.x=element_text(angle=40, hjust=1))

ptime

png(here('doc','supplement','FigC1-run-times-qpress.png'), res=300, height=1200,width=1200)
ptime
dev.off()
```


## Run each OM for every HCR

I mostly use this when there were iterative structural changes made to the QNMs

### OM 2

do you want to load new models?
```{r}
# m1 <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_2-thorsonF',dia_path=here('data'))[[1]]
# mb <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_2B-rm-small-mesh',dia_path=here('data'))[[1]] 
# mc <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Sep_2C-rm-small-mesh-redistribute-small',dia_path=here('data'))[[1]]

m1 <- m2list[[1]]
mb <- m2list[[2]]
mc <- m2list[[3]]
me <- m2list[[4]]

```

```{r}
# simulation prep
om_out <- list()   # empty list for simulation output
pert_list <- Pert.list
om_run_times <- list()

# run simulation
for(i in seq(1,length(pert_list))){
  
  # load 'i' operating model
  tmp_p <- pert_list[[i]]
  tmp_p_name <- names(pert_list)[i]
  
  # run simulation for HCR C
  if(grepl("B:",tmp_p_name)){
    s <- Sys.time()  # start timer
    om_out[[i]] <- system.simulate(n.sims=10000, # number of randomly generated matrices to keep
                                   edges=mb, # the qnm
                                   sampler=community.sampler(mb, required.groups = c(0)), # thefx to generate the matrices without constraints
                                   validators=list(press.validate(
                                     mb, # the qnm
                                     perturb = tmp_p, # the perturbation
                                     monitor = NA))) # a list of expected outcomes that should happen in the simulation (I don't usually use this)
    names(om_out)[i] <- tmp_p_name
    
  } else if(grepl("C:",tmp_p_name)){
    s <- Sys.time()  # start timer
    om_out[[i]] <- system.simulate(n.sims=10000, # number of randomly generated matrices to keep
                                   edges=mc, # the qnm
                                   sampler=community.sampler(mc, required.groups = c(0)), # thefx to generate the matrices without constraints
                                   validators=list(press.validate(
                                     mc, # the qnm
                                     perturb = tmp_p, # the perturbation
                                     monitor = NA))) # a list of expected outcomes that should happen in the simulation (I don't usually use this)
    names(om_out)[i] <- tmp_p_name
    
  } else if(grepl("E:",tmp_p_name)){
    s <- Sys.time()  # start timer
    om_out[[i]] <- system.simulate(n.sims=10000, # number of randomly generated matrices to keep
                                   edges=me, # the qnm
                                   sampler=community.sampler(me, required.groups = c(0)), # thefx to generate the matrices without constraints
                                   validators=list(press.validate(
                                     me, # the qnm
                                     perturb = tmp_p, # the perturbation
                                     monitor = NA))) # a list of expected outcomes that should happen in the simulation (I don't usually use this)
    names(om_out)[i] <- tmp_p_name
    } else{
    # run simulation for HCR A-B, D-E
    s <- Sys.time()  # start timer
    om_out[[i]] <- system.simulate(n.sims=10000, # number of randomly generated matrices to keep
                                   edges=m1, # the qnm
                                   sampler=community.sampler(m1, required.groups = c(0)), # thefx to generate the matrices without constraints
                                   validators=list(press.validate(
                                     m1, # the qnm
                                     perturb = tmp_p, # the perturbation
                                     monitor = NA))) # a list of expected outcomes that should happen in the simulation (I don't usually use this)
    names(om_out)[i] <- tmp_p_name
  }
  
  # save time info
  om_run_times[length(om_run_times)+1] <- end.timer(s)    # end timer
  names(om_run_times)[length(om_run_times)]
  
}
compare.table <- compare.models.impact.tbl(sim.list=om_out, # **named** list of simulations to look at
                                          perturb.list=pert_list,
                                          monitor.list=list(NA,NA,NA,NA,NA), # list of variable outcomes monitored (I don't use this)
                                          strong_lower=0.8, weak_lower=0.6,
                                          epsilon=1.0E-5,
                                          plot=TRUE, main.axis="Y",
                                          variable.key=vkey,variable.order="specific_order")
## plot (this one should show all perturbations in a single plot, so no need to use plot_grid)
plot.out <- compare.table[[3]] +
  labs(subtitle="OM 2 Thorson Effort")
plot.out
```

### Revise an OM

Written for revising QNM 4 (Inaccessible offshore biomass)
do you want to load new models?
```{r}
# m1 <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_004-2-movement-to-inaccessible',dia_path=here('data'))[[1]]  # no constraints
# mc <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_004-2C-rm-small-mesh-redistribute-small',dia_path=here('data'))[[1]]  # no constraints

m1 <- mlist4[[1]]
mc <- mlist4[[2]]

Pert.list.sub <- list(PertA, PertC)
```

```{r}
# simulation prep
om_out <- list()   # empty list for simulation output
pert_list <- lapply(Pert.list.sub, FUN=function(x){return(c(x,PertOM4))})     # OM 4:  There a positive perturbation on “climate pressure"
om_run_times <- list()

# run simulation
for(i in seq(1,length(pert_list))){
  
  # load 'i' operating model
  tmp_p <- pert_list[[i]]
  tmp_p_name <- names(pert_list)[i]
  
  # run simulation for HCR C
  if(grepl("Effort redistribution",tmp_p_name)){
    s <- Sys.time()  # start timer
    om_out[[i]] <- system.simulate(n.sims=10000, # number of randomly generated matrices to keep
                                    edges=mc, # the qnm
                                    sampler=community.sampler(mc, required.groups = c(0)), # thefx to generate the matrices without constraints
                                    validators=list(press.validate(
                                      mc, # the qnm
                                      perturb = tmp_p, # the perturbation
                                      monitor = NA))) # a list of expected outcomes that should happen in the simulation (I don't usually use this)
    names(om_out)[i] <- tmp_p_name
    
  } else{
    # run simulation for HCR A-B, D-E
    s <- Sys.time()  # start timer
    om_out[[i]] <- system.simulate(n.sims=10000, # number of randomly generated matrices to keep
                                    edges=m1, # the qnm
                                    sampler=community.sampler(m1, required.groups = c(0)), # thefx to generate the matrices without constraints
                                    validators=list(press.validate(
                                      m1, # the qnm
                                      perturb = tmp_p, # the perturbation
                                      monitor = NA))) # a list of expected outcomes that should happen in the simulation (I don't usually use this)
    names(om_out)[i] <- tmp_p_name
  }
  
  # save time info
  om_run_times[length(om_run_times)+1] <- end.timer(s)    # end timer
  names(om_run_times)[length(om_run_times)]
  
}

compare.table <- compare.models.impact.df(sim.list=om_out, # **named** list of simulations to look at
                                          perturb.list=pert_list,
                                          monitor.list=list(NA,NA,NA,NA,NA), # list of variable outcomes monitored (I don't use this)
                                          strong_lower=0.8, weak_lower=0.6,
                                          epsilon=1.0E-5,
                                          plot=TRUE, main.axis="Y",
                                          variable.key=vkey,variable.order="specific_order")
## plot (this one should show all perturbations in a single plot, so no need to use plot_grid)
plot.out <- compare.models.impact.tbl[[3]] +
  labs(subtitle="OM 4 Offshore inaccessible biomass") 
plot.out
```

#### Re-save by Perturbation

after running (or re-running) certain OMs, 
save the new versions into the simulation lists
```{r eval=FALSE}
om <- 4

# simulation output saved as lists from above
hcrA_out <- readRDS(here('data','qnm_out','mse0-5_hcrA_10K_20240919.rds'))
# hcrB_out <- readRDS(here('data','qnm_out','mse0-5_hcrB_10K_20240919.rds'))
hcrC_out <- readRDS(here('data','qnm_out','mse0-5_hcrC_10K_20240919.rds'))
# hcrD_out <- readRDS(here('data','qnm_out','mse0-5_hcrD_10K_20240919.rds'))
# hcrE_out <- readRDS(here('data','qnm_out','mse0-5_hcrE_10K_20240919.rds'))

all_old_lists <- list(hcrA_out,hcrC_out)
names(all_old_lists) <- c("A","C")
# all_old_lists <- list(hcrA_out,hcrB_out,hcrC_out,hcrD_out,hcrE_out)
# names(all_old_lists) <- c("A","B","C","D","E")

  
# add in new OM 4, Save again
for(i in seq(1:length(all_old_lists))){
  all_old_lists[[i]][[om]] <- om_out[[i]]
  length(all_old_lists[[i]]) == 5
  saveRDS(all_old_lists, here('data','qnm_out',paste0('mse0-5_hcr',names(all_old_lists)[i],'_10K_20240919.rds')))
}
```
